query: UPDATE ops.agent_suggestions SET status='ACCEPTED',decision_reason=$2,decided_by=$3,decided_at=clock_timestamp(),version=version+1,decision_kind='ACCEPT',decision_sha256=CAST($4 AS char(64)),decision_audit_event_id=$5,materialized_target_type='ACTION_PROPOSAL_DRAFT',materialized_target_id=$6,materialized_target_version=1,materialized_target_digest=CAST($7 AS char(64)),materialized_action_proposal_id=$6,materialization_receipt_sha256=CAST($8 AS char(64)) WHERE id=$1 AND version=$9
